$comment: Conversions of fixtures/rates-snapshot.json, computed once by hand from docs/architecture.md §5 and asserted by both implementations: apps/api/test/e2e/conversion.e2e-spec.ts over HTTP, and apps/web/src/features/converter/__tests__/convertOffline.test.ts in the browser copy. The rate is rounded half-up to six decimals and the money to two, and the money is computed from the *unrounded* rate — the UAH -> PLN million is the vector that fails if either side rounds the rate first. Run `npm run check:fixtures` after editing.

vectors.note: Base into quote pays what the bank buys the base at.
Quote back into base pays one over what the bank sells the base at: 1 / 44.831.
The published pair wins over the path through the hryvnia, which would lose a second spread.
The same pair the other way: 1 / 1.1739.
Both legs on mid rates: 60.7562 out, 1 / 12.1834 back.
§3's own worked example: two currencies quoted against the hryvnia and not against each other.
A quoted code against itself is one, before any pair is looked up.
Less than half a cent is worth zero, and it is a success: `rate` is what makes the zero readable.
